title: Selling Plans Store Discount on Northloop Payments Instant Payout Rates
content:
The store plan a seller holds under Selling Plans lowers the instant fee rate charged on the seller's Northloop Payments instant payouts.

**Rule.** From the volume-priced rate Northloop subtracts a store-plan rate discount of 0.0025 when the seller's selling plan is Anchor Store or Enterprise Store, 0.0010 when it is Premium Store, and nothing on any other selling plan. The rate so combined is applied once to the payout amount.

## Discount by selling plan

| Seller's plan under Selling Plans | Store-plan rate discount subtracted from the rate |
|---|---|
| Anchor Store | 0.0025 |
| Enterprise Store | 0.0025 |
| Premium Store | 0.0010 |
| any other selling plan | nothing |

The plan read is the seller's current plan on the Selling Plans record.

*Hypothetical example.* From a volume-priced rate of 0.0150, the store-plan rate discount of a seller on Premium Store takes 0.0010 off, leaving 0.0140 before any other part of the rate is combined; on Anchor Store the discount takes 0.0025 off, leaving 0.0125.
